# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest published Android release and the currently deployed web application.

Dependency alerts and updates, secret scanning with push protection, and CodeQL analysis are enabled for this repository.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

- Email: scenesuastudio@gmail.com
- Private report: https://github.com/scenesua/Lullaby-scene/security/advisories/new

Include the affected URL or version, reproduction steps, impact, and any relevant logs or screenshots. Please allow a reasonable period for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.
